candidate.name: Extended Kraus Sieve for (3, 3, p) on p in [1701, 1800]
candidate.text: Candidate: Extended exact modular Kraus sieve for Beal signature (3, 3, p) across prime exponents p in [1701, 1800]. Uses multi-modulus auxiliary primes l = 2*k*p + 1 to eliminate potential mod-p isomorphisms between Frey elliptic curves E_{A,B} and weight-2 newforms at conductor levels 72 and 144. Provides unconditional exact integer certificate verified independently in PARI/GP.

legend.0: level 0: peripheral or unrelated to Beal signatures
legend.1: level 1: general modular method context without resolving any signature
legend.2: level 2: settles a concrete range of exponents or a new specific signature family
legend.3: level 3: settles an entire infinite signature family for all exponents
legend.4: level 4: resolves the complete conjecture outright
